title: The man in the Shroud of Turin was alive

tellings.quote: The man in the shroud was living.

related.note: Both are about what the Shroud records of the man in it, but Strieber says it shows a body that had died and turned into light, while this telling says the man was alive.

plain: The man whose image appears on the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth kept in Turin that many believe was Jesus's burial cloth, was alive when it was made. A researcher of ancient catastrophes named Randall Carlson says this to Michels, putting it simply: 'The man in the shroud was living.' The Gospels tell of Jesus dying and then being wrapped in linen for burial, so Carlson's claim, if true, would mean the cloth wrapped a man who was not dead.
